name: PingPlotter
description_en:
PingPlotter is a product in the Network monitoring category. Its directory profile covers Uptime Monitoring, SLA Monitoring, Server Monitoring, IP Address Monitoring, Diagnostic Tools, Bandwidth Monitoring.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $9.99. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: check whether selected services respond as expected; track selected server status and resource signals. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
